notes:
v1.0.35 — five changes in one release:
1) OBS DEEP-FIX (game-side): the bundled FPS Boost mod now audits the capture-hook path — no anti-hook hardening anywhere, borderless windowed fullscreen preferred (OBS Game Capture hooks the fast shared-GPU-texture path instead of falling back to slow Display Capture), and the present/swap path stays standard. Logs whether a capture tool is detected (OBS/Discord) so a real recording-session FPS comparison can be measured.
2) NO MORE "NOT RESPONDING" while loading (game-side): resource-pack/shader reloads now keep the game window pumping messages and rendering a loading screen the whole time (LoadingBoost module) — heavy texture/decode/compile work stays fully off the window thread.
3) SOUND SYSTEM: single Aurora theme (Crystal and Zen removed, theme picker deleted — sound is just on/off now), two new short cues — a gentle chime when an update is available and a satisfying completion sound on any install/download finishing (mod install, update install, profile ready) — and every existing sound normalized to a soft, non-fatiguing loudness.
4) SIDEBAR: the big REIMAGINED LAUNCHER wordmark above MAIN is gone (expanded and collapsed) — the sidebar starts clean with the MAIN section.
5) UPDATE BUTTON: the text button under Account is now a minimal down-arrow icon (same click = same update flow) with a smooth hover tooltip showing "Update available: vX.X.X" from the real update check.
Bundled FPS Boost upgraded to 1.0.11 (auto-upgraded for every profile on next launch).
